og.alt: Format (@pyreon/format): Change the language once. Every price and date follows.

hero.alt: Schematic: setLocale switches the language from en-US to German to Czech. A price (€1,234.50, then 1.234,50 €, then 1 234,50 €), a file size, a date (November 18, 2026, then 18. November 2026, then 18. listopadu 2026) and a relative time (yesterday, gestern, včera) each rewrite in place. A panel lists the four function calls, none of which takes a locale.
